meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 安装后 Claude 会为 NanoClaw 接入 Slack：从 channels 分支复制适配器并注册、装好 @chat-adapter/slack，引导你创建 Slack 应用、填写令牌，最后重启服务。完成后它能在 Slack 频道和私信里收发消息。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 接入 Slack 频道时触发；可在 /setup 流程中执行，或之后用 /init-first-agent 等命令接线。

say.text: 帮我把 Slack 接入 NanoClaw，用 Socket Mode。
say.note: 会引导你创建 Slack 应用并收集令牌。

say.text: 我的 Slack 成员 ID 是 U12345678，帮我配好私信频道。
say.note: 会解析 DM 频道并写入配置。

howto.what_en: Claude adds Slack to NanoClaw: copies the Slack adapter, registers it, installs @chat-adapter/slack, guides you through creating the Slack app and storing tokens, then restarts the service to send and receive Slack messages.
howto.when_en: Runs when you want to add a Slack channel to NanoClaw — during /setup, or later via /init-first-agent or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add Slack to NanoClaw using Socket Mode.
say_en.note: Guides you through creating the Slack app and tokens.

say_en.text: My Slack member ID is U12345678 — set up my DM channel.
say_en.note: Resolves the DM channel and writes credentials.

say_en.text: Connect Slack via webhook; my public URL is https://example.com.
say_en.note: Asks for a public HTTPS webhook URL.
